methodologyNotes: Covers standalone handheld thermal imaging cameras sold at a published US MSRP. Excludes smartphone clip-on attachments. Price is MSRP at launch in USD. Resolution listed as sensor pixels (rows x columns), NOT interpolated. Refresh rate in Hz. Temperature range in degrees C. NETD in mK (lower is better); null if not disclosed. Field of view in degrees. Display size in inches. Battery life in hours. Weight in grams.
